items.pattern: Past Simple + would + base for an unreal past
items.sk: Ide o minulosť, ktorá sa nestala, preto Third Conditional: „{right}“.
items.cz: Jde o minulost, která se nestala, proto Third Conditional: „{right}“.
items.en: An unreal past situation needs the Third Conditional: “{right}”.

items.pattern: would (have) + verb after if
items.sk: Po „if“ nepatrí „would“; v Third Conditional je tam Past Perfect: „{right}“.
items.cz: Po „if“ nepatří „would“; ve Third Conditional je tam Past Perfect: „{right}“.
items.en: No “would” after “if”; the Third Conditional uses Past Perfect: “{right}”.

items.pattern: Past Simple instead of Past Perfect after if (result clause kept)
items.sk: Podmienka je v minulosti, preto po „if“ Past Perfect: „{right}“, nie „{wrong}“.
items.cz: Podmínka je v minulosti, proto po „if“ Past Perfect: „{right}“, ne „{wrong}“.
items.en: The condition is past, so Past Perfect after “if”: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: has/have + participle after if
items.sk: Po „if“ v Third Conditional patrí Past Perfect: „{right}“, nie „{wrong}“.
items.cz: Po „if“ ve Third Conditional patří Past Perfect: „{right}“, ne „{wrong}“.
items.en: After “if” the Third Conditional uses Past Perfect: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.kind: present result for a past result
items.pattern: would + base where the result is clearly over (event finished)
items.sk: Následok je tiež v minulosti: „{right}“, nie „{wrong}“.
items.cz: Následek je také v minulosti: „{right}“, ne „{wrong}“.
items.en: The result is in the past too: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.kind: present result that could be mixed
items.pattern: would + base where a present result still makes sense
items.sk: Následok je v minulosti, preto v Third Conditional: „{right}“.
items.cz: Následek je v minulosti, proto ve Third Conditional: „{right}“.
items.en: The result is in the past, so the Third Conditional: “{right}”.

items.pattern: would have + participle where the result is true now (Mixed)
items.en: The result is true now, so “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: would had + participle
items.en: After “would” always use “have”, not “had”: “{right}”.

items.pattern: would of / could of instead of would have
items.en: Write “would have” (or “would've”), not “would of”.

items.pattern: would + participle (have dropped)
items.en: “have” is missing: “would have” + past participle: “{right}”.

items.pattern: would have + base form
items.sk: Po „would have“ patrí past participle: „{right}“, nie „{wrong}“.
items.cz: Po „would have“ následuje past participle: „{right}“, ne „{wrong}“.
items.en: After “would have” use the past participle: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: if + had + base form
items.en: After “had” use the past participle: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: had/have + Past Simple form (would have went)
items.en: After “have/had” use the past participle: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: will have + participle in the result clause
items.sk: V Third Conditional patrí „would have“, nie „will have“: „{right}“.
items.cz: Ve Third Conditional patří „would have“, ne „will have“: „{right}“.
items.en: The Third Conditional uses “would have”, not “will have”: “{right}”.

items.pattern: had + participle in the result clause instead of would have
items.sk: V hlavnej vete patrí „would have“ + past participle: „{right}“.
items.cz: V hlavní větě patří „would have“ + past participle: „{right}“.
items.en: The result clause needs “would have” + past participle: “{right}”.

items.pattern: when instead of if for an unreal condition
items.en: An unreal condition takes “if”; “when” means it really happened.

items.pattern: unless used for 'if … not' with an unreal past
items.en: “unless” changes the meaning here; use “if … not”: “{right}”.

items.pattern: two negatives in one clause (wouldn't … no)
items.sk: V angličtine je len jeden zápor: „{right}“.
items.cz: V angličtině je jen jeden zápor: „{right}“.
items.en: English allows only one negative here: “{right}”.

items.pattern: still placed after be before an adverb/adjective (would be still here)
items.en: “still” goes right after “would”: “{right}”.

items.pattern: still placed after be before an -ing form (would be still crying)
items.en: “still” sounds more natural right after “would”: “{right}”.

items.pattern: more + short adjective/adverb (more early, more thick)
items.en: A short word takes -er: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.
